$comment: Organisations module (data-model §3.2; REQ-ORG-001..004, DR-A05/A06/A14; TASK-037). TENANT tables. organisations is keyed on id (its own tenant key, C2 special case) with the DR-A14 organisations set; memberships keeps the tenant block plus the DR-A14 own-read branch; both are read by the SECURITY DEFINER platform.app_is_operator() and the §4.5 functions (definerRead). invitations is the whole pending state of an invitation (D-ARCH-123), read by invitation_lookup (definerRead). Every table carries the full standard-column set and is runtime-writable (stdColumns: trg_<table>__std_columns, C15).
